stem: Which quotation from the play best reveals Anna Maria's reason for becoming angry with Leopold?

options.label: F
options.text: ANNA MARIA: But we have done very well in London, Leopold. Why is this one night keeping you in such a fuss? (line 5)

options.label: G
options.text: ANNA MARIA: Honestly, Leopold. I should think you would be more concerned over all the dreadful rumors about Wolferl's abilities. (line 8)

options.label: H
options.text: ANNA MARIA: Mr. Barrington, how would such a test be given? (line 35)

options.label: J
options.text: ANNA MARIA: You have never let him be a child—always pushing him to live up to your dreams. (line 54)
